name: Battle of the Dragon and Mouse
description:
Based on Lin Yühsia's understanding, it's completely acceptable here to hit first and ask questions later. She'd been planning to do so anyway. 
<High Tide>Unable to deploy on flooded tiles. Allied units and enemies in the water will suffer from 'Erosion'
Condition:Increased 'Erosion' damage, and Unmanned Heavy Explosive Boats lose HP at a decreased rate

abilities.text: Death deals Physical damage and <$ba.dt.erosion>Corrosion damage</> to surrounding units
Has a chance to dodge Physical attacks when not blocked
Quickly loses HP while under the effects of 'Erosion'
Immune to Erosion. While in water, gains increased ATK and <$ba.invisible>Invisibility</>
Can only be blocked by units with at least 3 Block, and deals Physical damage by colliding with player's units
The <Dockworker Leader> will continue battle after the vehicle is destroyed
